response.query: What pre-specified rule should determine when to display an uncertainty range versus a point estimate on a true-price label (e.g., CV threshold, percentile bounds, rounding rules)?
response.answer: Display an uncertainty range on a true-price label when the confidence interval exceeds a predefined threshold, typically 95% or higher, to reflect statistical significance. Use a point estimate when the range is narrow and precise.
